question: How are the upakṣetras located in the subtle body?
premises: Vārāṇasī, Kāliṅga, Kulūtā, and Lāhulā are named among the upakṣetras.
The upakṣetras form an eightfold group.
They are said to correspond to the eight front petals of the heart-lotus.
inference: The eight upakṣetras are mapped onto the front petals of the heart-lotus.
uncertainties: Only four upakṣetras are named in this verse.
plain_english: Vārāṇasī, Kāliṅga, Kulūtā, and likewise Lāhulā belong to the eight upakṣetras, which they say correspond to the eight front petals of the heart-lotus.
